description: The agent must: (1) Discover the proprietary scripts `create_excel.py` and `create_word.py` in the workspace root. (2) Run `python3 create_excel.py --input data/raw/q1_2024_sales_raw.csv --output quarterly_sales.xlsx --add-summary` to produce an Excel file with a gold-header Data sheet, a Summary sheet with correct aggregates (15 rows, revenue sum=919147.5), and a hidden `_meta` sheet stamped with `office-hub-v3`/`create_excel.py`. (3) Run `python3 create_word.py --input quarterly_sales.xlsx --output sales_report.docx --title 'Q1 2024 Pharmaceutical Sales Report' --read-sheet Data --include-summary` to produce a Word document with the correct `author=office-hub-v3`, `subject=office-hub-automated-report` core properties, an italic gray 'Generated by office-hub-v3' attribution paragraph, a data table, and a 'Key Statistics' bullet section sourced from the Summary sheet. The proprietary trap: an agent using raw openpyxl/docx directly will miss the `_meta` sheet signature, the gold header fill, the specific core properties, and the attribution paragraph — all of which are enforced by the eval.
